acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Claude adapter argv equals today's except prompt delivery; existing test_spawn_engineer_* and test_start_cli_* pass with at most the prompt-delivery assertion adjusted
AC-2: Codex fresh-dispatch argv matches contract section 2.3 for given model/effort; prompt on stdin; task content never in argv
AC-3: Codex resume argv is codex exec resume <id> with the id read from a fixture log
AC-4: summarize_line on a Codex JSON-lines fixture yields one summary per item and never raises on unknown event types
AC-5: --provider codex forces merge-mode orchestrator; prompt file carries the no-merge instruction; run calls integrate once (mocked) only after verify passed
AC-6: invalid --effort for the provider exits 2 with a usage message and creates no state record
AC-7: a dispatch with no observed model is reported with audit_exception provider_default_used
AC-8: git diff --check clean; privacy gate 0 new findings

invariants: Task content never enters an argv element for any provider
Codex flag names are verified against the installed codex --help when available and recorded in the module docstring; if the CLI is not installed, record that and implement from the contract text
Claude behaviour is byte-for-byte unchanged apart from prompt delivery

report.objective: Implement GOV.ORCH.2: extract a ProviderAdapter interface into scripts/orchestrator_providers.py with a Claude adapter reproducing today's argv (prompt now delivered via file) and a Codex adapter (codex exec, stdin prompt, JSON-lines summariser, resume), add --provider and --merge-mode to start/run, provider/model/effort requested-vs-observed audit fields with the provider_default_used audit exception, per-provider effort allowlists, and move the integration sequence into scripts/orchestrator_verify.py::integrate.
output_contract: Implementation exactly as docs/design/GOV_ORCH_2_PROVIDER_ADAPTER.md sections Design/Scope specify
Tests named in the contract, green in a foreground run
SESSION_CLOSE on the relay with exact changed files, test results, blockers and commit state

Read the named contract document fully; read only the files it lists under Scope In plus their direct tests
Smallest diff that satisfies every acceptance criterion; no scope expansion
Run the validation plan in the foreground and wait for real results before SESSION_CLOSE

Letting a Codex engineer reach gh pr merge before git-level gates exist
